title: 4.0.0.0-dev Dexcom CGM granting permission
body:
Version: 
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fedb446a-4adc-4446-bd16-bcbea4ee21a6)
CGM: Dexcom G7 (BYODA DiaKEM)

Description:
I see a popup whereI have to grant permission for reading CGM.
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ec4e06f2-ebf6-49c5-939d-3220b5071c7e)
Granting permission does not work. Clicking "Grant" looks like it's doing nothing.
But functionality is fully given. I am getting CGM values and I'm fully closed looping successfully.
The grant permissions popup is opening regularly so it's a bit annoying.

Logfile:
[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26659445/AndroidAPS.log)

PS:
Very nice UI in version 4.0. Thanks for that hard work.
